project_type: Full-stack civic issue reporting platform — Express/MongoDB backend + React/Vite frontend (monorepo, two separate package.json roots)
language: JavaScript (CommonJS backend, ESM frontend via Vite + React)
build_system: Vite (frontend at frontend/), Node/Express (backend at backend/). No workspace-level build script — each side is run independently.
test_framework: None configured (no test runner found in either package.json). Verification is done via syntax checks and manual browser testing.
build_command: cd frontend && npm run build   (Vite production build; checks for JSX/import errors)
test_command: node --check <file>   for backend JS syntax; cd frontend && npm run build for frontend JSX syntax.
verification_instructions: 1. Run `node --check <backend-file>` for every changed backend file to confirm no syntax errors. 2. Run `cd frontend && npm run build` to confirm no broken imports or JSX errors. 3. Manually start backend (`cd backend && node server.js`) and frontend (`cd frontend && npm run dev`) to verify runtime behaviour.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell. `head` is not a valid PowerShell command — use `Get-Content | Select-Object -First N` or the read_file tool with limit. No automated test suite exists.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md found. Follow existing code style: 2-space indent in JSX, Tailwind utility classes, Lucide icons, no new libraries without justification.
key_patterns: Frontend auth: `const { user } = useAuth()` from '../../context/AuthContext'. Authority check used in Sidebar: `const isAuthority = user?.role === 'sub-admin' || user?.role === 'super-admin'`. MyReports.jsx uses a normalizeRole() helper and checks `isCitizen` before rendering the Report Issue button — already correct. Navbar renders the Report Issue Link inside `{user && (...)}` but without authority guard — needs fix. Sidebar bottom CTA card navigates to '/report' for ALL users — needs authority guard. Backend workers use CommonJS require/exports. server.js has a `start()` async function that calls connectDB() then app.listen(). SLA worker currently calls mongoose.connect/disconnect itself and is not wired into server.js.
directory_structure: backend/ — Express server, controllers/, models/, routes/, workers/, utils/cryptoAudit.js, config/db.js, server.js. frontend/src/ — pages/ (Auth/, Authority/, Citizen/, Profile/, Home.jsx, MyReports.jsx, etc.), components/ (layout/Navbar.jsx, layout/Sidebar.jsx, issues/IssueCard.jsx, AuditLedgerModal.jsx), context/ (AuthContext.jsx, LanguageContext.jsx), hooks/ (empty — useVoiceToText.js does not yet exist), lib/api.js, constants/index.js.
